risks.risk: The table may be damaged or the bed may be warped.

Video of the motor running to check for noise or vibration.
Close-up photos of the table surface and the underside of the bed.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
